integrity: The proof separates the symbolic multiplicative/Euler-product argument from a finite exact rational enumeration. The packaged verifier uses only integer arithmetic and Fraction objects; no sampling is used to certify the bound.
scientific_limitations: This is an explicit lower bound obtained from a finite family of valuation cylinders; it is not claimed optimal and does not determine the exact density.
title: An explicit \(0.753659844\ldots\) lower bound for the unitary--exponential divisor-sum comparison density
